description:
Gu Chan-Yang, known as the X-scholar in the department. Because of his old-fashioned personality, he once earned the dishonorable title of group project villain. Everyone avoids him, but he has already reached the maximum number of semesters off, and he absolutely must finish the group project successfully and graduate this year! Shin Ha-Gyeol, a fellow group member and a ruffian, appears in front of Chan-Yang. He asks Chan-Yang for help, saying that he has been possessed by a magpie spirit... In order to consecrate the magpie spirit, he needs to obtain the dragon's teeth? How on earth will he do it?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
